as_told.title: Calf dies with a UFO caught on camera above it

plain: Skinwalker Ranch is a property in Utah known for stories of strange events, and podcast host Jesse Michels says that one of the most disturbing things there was when a healthy two-year-old young cow was found dead with no injuries on the outside, an event he credits to a TV series about the ranch. The ranch's owner, Brandon Fugal, tells it firsthand, saying it happened in a field near a building called Homestead 1 and that cameras captured an object above the animal, crediting two of his team, Thomas Winterton and Caleb Benches. If true, it would tie the cow's death to an unknown craft.
